_readme: Template only. Copy to cameras.json in this folder, fill it in and delete the '_example' line; the main_*.py scripts refuse to run a config that still has it. Shared: other configs pull it in with "_include", so it is set once. Used by steps 7 to 9.

cameras._readme: Calibration for main_points3d.py / main_tracks3d.py (OpenCV conventions). One entry per camera; each is paired with the batch input whose folder name contains the camera name (or its optional 'match' string). matrix = 3x3 intrinsics. distortions = k1 k2 p1 p2 k3 for model 'pinhole' (k1 k2 k3 k4 for 'fisheye'). rotation (Rodrigues vector, or a 3x3 matrix) and translation are WORLD -> CAMERA, as returned by stereoCalibrate / solvePnP; the reference camera has rotation [0, 0, 0] and translation [0, 0, 0]. translation is multiplied by t_scale (1000: calibration in metres, world in mm). image_size = [width, height] the calibration was done at (matrix is rescaled if the videos differ). frame_offset is added to that camera's frame numbers to synchronise the views.
